obligations.target_sector: classical general relativity and tested strong/weak-field gravitational behavior
obligations.minimum_for_S4: the route must recover the relevant tested GR regime it claims to replace or explain, including a public map from native variables to metric / curvature / waveform observables
obligations.minimum_for_S5: the route must recover all observed classical-gravity regimes in scope and survive cross-family alternatives that agree on those public records
obligations.current_archive_state: open constraint corridor; GW and classical-limit rows are record-rich but not ToE-identifying
obligations.decisive_missing_piece: native-to-public map that is both regime-complete and cross-family discriminating
obligations.residual_cap: classical-GR recovery is mandatory but not identifying by itself

obligations.target_sector: quantum mechanics, QFT/EFT behavior, gauge structure, and known low-energy consistency
obligations.minimum_for_S4: the route must state how ordinary quantum records, gauge constraints, and low-energy EFT observables are recovered or bounded inside the claimed regime
obligations.minimum_for_S5: the route must recover the quantum/EFT record layer across the observed sector without hiding decisive measurement or gauge debt in external vocabulary
obligations.current_archive_state: open; several routes borrow standard QFT/public-lab semantics
obligations.decisive_missing_piece: candidate-native account of public quantum records and gauge-local operations
obligations.residual_cap: QFT compatibility can constrain candidates but cannot choose a full candidate alone

obligations.target_sector: Standard Model matter, gauge content, flavor, masses, neutrinos, and observed-sector parameter fixation
obligations.minimum_for_S4: the route must declare whether matter content is recovered, assumed, compactification-selected, emergent, or outside scope
obligations.minimum_for_S5: the route must recover observed matter content and parameter structure at the claimed target grain without post-hoc selection or hidden anthropic / compactification choices
obligations.current_archive_state: open; string/M has target richness but no observed-sector inverse closure
obligations.decisive_missing_piece: observed-sector inverse map that does not depend on post-hoc vacuum, truncation, or matter-insertion choices
obligations.residual_cap: matter-sector recovery is a ToE burden, not a generic completion-label credit

obligations.target_sector: cosmology, vacuum energy, dark-energy behavior, initial/boundary conditions, and global constraints
obligations.minimum_for_S4: the route must identify which cosmological package assumptions are native and which are boundary / measure / selection inputs
obligations.minimum_for_S5: the route must recover observed cosmological behavior and vacuum-sector facts without conflating local-law success with cosmological-package closure
obligations.current_archive_state: open; the archive already separates local-law, cosmological-package, and witness-package credit
obligations.decisive_missing_piece: native cosmological boundary/measure/selection account with public-record consequences
obligations.residual_cap: cosmological fit or vacuum relief cannot stand in for local-law or witness closure

obligations.target_sector: black-hole thermodynamics, entropy, information, horizons, and reconstruction limits
obligations.minimum_for_S4: the route must recover the black-hole/horizon records it invokes and state the access regime: asymptotic, boundary, code-subspace, edge, detector, or relational
obligations.minimum_for_S5: the route must integrate black-hole records with observed-sector recovery and public witness portability across candidate quotients
obligations.current_archive_state: open; Family C is strongest but package-bounded
obligations.decisive_missing_piece: public bridge and cross-package target quotient for reconstruction results
obligations.residual_cap: holographic/reconstruction power is bounded partial-identification credit unless public witness and quotient debts close

obligations.target_sector: laboratory quantum-gravity / mediator / graviton-access discriminator records
obligations.minimum_for_S4: the route must produce challengeable public records and discriminate a candidate-native target quotient, not only a mediator class or source state
obligations.minimum_for_S5: the route must connect discriminator records to full observed-sector recovery and eliminate cross-family candidate countermodels
obligations.current_archive_state: open; lab routes are record-richer corridors but target-poor
obligations.decisive_missing_piece: target quotient and candidate-native public bridge beyond class-level quantization or state-characterization
obligations.residual_cap: even successful quantum-gravity lab records do not identify a ToE candidate without native target quotient and observed-sector integration

obligations.target_sector: public record custody, replay, equivalence, reference standards, and witness-package portability

obligations.minimum_for_S5: the route must make those witness debts candidate-native and portable across observed-sector record types
obligations.current_archive_state: open; route rows improve discipline but do not close the witness package
